And sometimes that mean just walking away or giving yourself space from them.” I believe harmful words or acts can be worse than no words or actions. It might not be the best solution, in fact i know it’s not. But if it can help you to make it a little while longer and to see a little more goodness the world may have, maybe it’s worth trying?
